Agents that work for everyone in the room. No surprise there are already 10K+ company teams on it.

I've been exploring a lot of AI tools, but Teamily AI (@Teamily_AI) has a different take on how we work with agents.

Instead of managing separate AI chats, you can bring agents and teammates into one group, give everyone a role, and let Loops handle recurring tasks automatically.

Going from 10K to 320K sign-ups in just one quarter (32×) is pretty impressive.

I think team-based AI workflows are going to be a big part of how we work in the future.
